title: Experiment Design & Power
description: Go beyond basic significance: calculate how many users you need before launching, understand the consequences of underpowered tests, diagnose a sample ratio mismatch, decide when your experiment has run long enough, and apply multiple testing corrections when you track more than one metric.
focus_concepts: TYPE I AND TYPE II ERRORS
outcomes: You'll compute a minimum sample size from effect size, alpha, and power inputs, explain what an underpowered test risks, identify a sample ratio mismatch from assignment logs and trace its likely causes, decide when novelty inflation means an experiment needs to run longer, and apply Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg correction for multi-metric tests.
